crossRefs.note: Whose confidence will break apart, Whose trust is a spider’s web.
He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
For the moth will eat them up like a garment, and the worm will eat them like wool; but my righteousness will be…
The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.
My dwelling is removed, and is carried away from me like a shepherd’s tent. I have rolled up my life like a weaver. He…
He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden. He has destroyed his place of assembly. Yahweh…

translations.web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
translations.bsb: The house he built is like a moth’s cocoon, like a hut set up by a watchman.
translations.kjv: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
translations.asv: He buildeth his house as the moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.
